Proven:
- seven core Grok behavioural objects pass Alchemy v0.8 STANDARD adoption with zero warnings, zero reserved-base overrides and INIT construction provenance;
- real-time and Batch WLU planner/estimator pairs also pass Alchemy v0.8 STANDARD adoption with zero warnings and INIT construction provenance;
- every direct Grok Alchemy object has migrated off compatibility initAlchemy();
- real-time POSTJSON and batch REQUESTJSON are protected security-sensitive transport surfaces;
- Secret Broker v0.2 trusted-consumer materialization is used on both real-time and Batch transport paths;
- the Batch curl fixture proves mode-0600 credential config materialization and no secret value on argv;
- a Batch lease is active inside trusted transport and retired after return;
- rejected Batch model policy does not acquire a credential lease;
- real installed curl fixture passes and secrets remain outside argv/instrumentation;
- real-time provider model/output policy executes before credential acquisition;
- capability selector enforces tier/zone/cost constraints and raises for impossible combinations;
- corrected economy cost-ceiling fixture uses 300 micro-USD: the economy route is 250 and STANDARD routes exceed the ceiling;
- Batch API no longer uses Rexx special variable RESULT as a mutable Directory;
- WLU v0.12 HTTP path reserves conservative 2,900,000 micro-WLU, settles provider-reported 500,000 micro-WLU, refunds unused capacity, and rejects exhausted-capacity work before provider invocation;
- Batch WLU remains long-horizon with distinct AI_BATCH_* facts and zero default delivery rate;
- prompts and raw credentials remain absent from Alchemy instrumentation.
